summary: One church, St. Ann, Raritan, whose bulletin's schedule box also lists the Oratory's other Raritan-area parishes (St. Joseph, Holy Trinity, the Shrine Chapel), excluded as their own parishes. Sunday 7:30, 10:30, 12:00 and 5:00 PM, Mon-Fri 8:00 AM and Saturday 9:00 AM Masses and Saturday confession after the 9 AM Mass agree in both bulletins (Nov 1 and Nov 15 issues) and their intentions. No open questions; no Adoration is printed.
